forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: No movement; no AGI announcements; Amodei still bullish near-term while Hassabis maintains ~50% by 2030.
forecasts.base_rate: Reference class: no breakthrough technology has been universally declared 'general intelligence' in the modern era. Lab CEO timelines (2027-2030) are upper-bound predictions with poor calibration history.

factors_up.factor: Continued capability gains in agentic frontier models (GPT-5, Claude 4.5, Gemini Ultra 2)
Amodei reiterated near-term AGI thesis at Davos 2026

factors_down.factor: Definition contestation — no broad consensus exists for 'AGI achieved'
Compute scaling slowdown signals and rising training costs

key_uncertainties: Whether 3 leading researchers would coordinate a public statement
Lab incentives to declare AGI for IPO/regulatory reasons

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: Slight uptick: McKinsey 10% cuts confirmed, BCG and Deloitte slowing, 40% productivity gains reported.
forecasts.base_rate: Past sectoral disruptions (e.g. travel agents, paralegals) show 33% declines over 5 years are rare but possible when productivity gains exceed 40%.

factors_up.factor: McKinsey announced cuts of 3,000-4,000 jobs (~10% of workforce) attributed to AI
Consulting firms report 40% productivity gains, compressing analyst pyramids
Entry-level postings dropping; 'pyramid' staffing model under pressure

factors_down.factor: Demand for AI strategy work partially offsetting headcount cuts
33% threshold is steep; definitional ambiguity around 'economic consultancy' vs broader consulting

key_uncertainties: Whether decline is attributed primarily to AI by analysts
Demand-side spillovers from AI strategy work
update_triggers: Industry revenue data showing 15%+ YoY decline
BLS/ONS employment data for consulting sector

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Labour at 18.7% in PollCheck moving average; Reform leads at 27.7%, Tories 18.1%. Labour now neck-and-neck with Conservatives.
forecasts.base_rate: Governing parties polling third 3+ years from election rarely recover to win plurality of seats.

factors_up.factor: Time to election (up to Dec 2029) — long horizon for recovery
Reform UK incumbency challenges if it forms next government
FPTP system can deliver pluralities on relatively low vote shares (~25-28%)

factors_down.factor: Labour approval at historic lows; sinking faster than May 2026 projection
Reform's sustained lead since May 2025
Even with vote efficiency, Labour seat count projected at ~19.5%

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Holding steady; 9-year window remains substantial. Continued model progress, but no near-term claim.
forecasts.base_rate: Aggregated forecaster medians (Metaculus, expert surveys) cluster 50-80% by 2035.

factors_up.factor: Continued frontier model capability scaling
Multiple labs (OAI, Anthropic, GDM) competing accelerates progress
Lab CEOs (Amodei, Altman) public near-term AGI predictions

factors_down.factor: Definitional ambiguity may delay public 'announcement' even if achieved
Compute/energy constraints could slow scaling
Possible regulation slowing AGI race

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: PLA continues blockade rehearsals (Strait Thunder 2025A, Justice Mission 2025) but no escalation. ODNI says no fixed timeline.
forecasts.base_rate: Inter-state war initiation by major nuclear-armed powers is rare; cross-strait military action has been deterred for 70+ years.

factors_up.factor: PLA practising LNG terminal strikes and port blockades in 2026 exercises
Xi reportedly told PLA to be ready for action by 2027
US-China relations volatility

factors_down.factor: ODNI March 2026 assessment: no fixed timeline, invasion unlikely 2027
Polymarket implied 0.7% for invasion by June 2026 (extreme deterrence priced in)
Economic costs of blockade/invasion would be enormous for PRC

key_uncertainties: Trigger events (Taiwan declaration, US election shift)

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: April 2026 CPI 2.8% (down from 3.3% in March); fastest disinflation since energy price cap. ~8 months remaining.
forecasts.base_rate: UK CPI has been above 2.0% every month since mid-2021; mean reversion possible but typically slow once inflation is anchored above target.

factors_up.factor: April 2026 CPI surprised at 2.8%, below 3.0% market expectation
Energy price cap from April 1 driving housing inflation lower
BoE on disinflationary easing path

factors_down.factor: Services inflation remains sticky above 4%
Wage growth still elevated
Need 80bp drop in ~8 months — historically rare absent shock

update_triggers: Monthly CPI prints (next: June 17 for May data)

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Tracking strongly: 1B trailer views, leading 2026 box office odds at 54.5% on Polymarket, July 31 release.
forecasts.base_rate: Only 5 superhero films have crossed $1.5B globally (Infinity War, Endgame, No Way Home, Furious 7, Avengers). Strong franchise + holiday window helps.

factors_up.factor: Trailer crossed 1B views in <1 week — Endgame-tier interest
Polymarket 54.5% to be #1 film of 2026
No Way Home grossed $1.92B as recent comp

factors_down.factor: 5-month window (Aug-Dec) tight for $1.5B given typical release curves
Avengers: Doomsday competing for same audience in 2026
China access uncertainty for Marvel films

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Already at combined ~$78B run-rate per May 2026 reporting (Anthropic $45B + OpenAI $33B). Q2 trajectory remains explosive.
forecasts.base_rate: Both firms growing 100%+ YoY; combined ARR threshold already exceeded in current data.

factors_up.factor: Anthropic on track for $10.9B in Q2 2026 alone (~$45B ARR)
OpenAI on track for $30B+ in 2026 annual revenue
Already crossed $70B combined run-rate per published estimates

factors_down.factor: Accounting disputes (OpenAI claims Anthropic's gross overstates by $8B)
Possible market correction or enterprise spend pullback

key_uncertainties: Final Q4 reporting basis (gross vs net)

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: OBR March 2026 EFO projects ~1.6% over forecast horizon, but 2030s subject to substantial productivity uncertainty.
forecasts.base_rate: UK average real GDP growth since 2010 has been ~1.4%. Reaching 1.5%+ in 2030s requires sustained productivity revival.

factors_up.factor: OBR forecasts 1.6% average over rest of forecast horizon
Potential AI-driven productivity boost in late 2020s/2030s
Possible planning reform and infrastructure investment effects

factors_down.factor: Persistent UK productivity slump since 2008
Aging demographics drag on potential growth
Fiscal headwinds and debt servicing costs
